sourceEvidence.claim: Lipofuscin — a yellow-brown 'wear and tear' pigment A associated with normal aging; composed of polymers of lipids and phospholipids complexed with protein; may be derived through lipid peroxidation of polyunsaturated lipids of subcellular membranes; autopsy of older adult will reveal deposits in heart, colon, liver, kidney, eye, and other organs
sourceEvidence.quote:
Lipofuscin

A yellow-brown, “wear and tear” pigment A associated with normal aging.
Composed of polymers of lipids and phospholipids complexed with protein. May be derived
through lipid peroxidation of polyunsaturated lipids of subcellular membranes.
Autopsy of older adult will reveal deposits in heart, colon, liver, kidney, eye, and other organs.

kypExtensions.summary: The pattern/trap/pivot/mini-case attack structure layered over the source facts.
kypExtensions.rationale: First Aid supplies the paraneoplastic table and the aging organ-system changes; the attack structure is a KYP design.

kypExtensions.summary: The two-axis rule (the paraneoplastic axis: 4 categories × 16 entries; the aging axis: 10 organ systems + Lipofuscin) — KYP's synthesis of the 3-page spread into one reading protocol.
kypExtensions.rationale: The source prints the sections sequentially without a unified protocol; the framing is KYP's design.

kypExtensions.summary: The four KYP mnemonics (SCLC MAKES HORMONES / THYMOMA THREE DISEASES / LAMBERT-EATEN PRESYNAPTIC MYASTHENIA POSTSYNAPTIC / WEAR AND TEAR LIPOFUSCIN) — no mnemonic prints on the page.
kypExtensions.rationale: No mnemonic prints anywhere on book 224-226 (VLM census confirmed); the four codes are KYP's design.

notes: Census (pdfimages + VLM): ONE copyrighted photograph on pdf 247 (book 225) — image 0, 175x126 cmyk jpeg at 150 dpi, the Lipofuscin 'wear and tear' pigment photograph lettered A beside the 'Lipofuscin A' text — described-in-text only, NEVER reproduced (the M32 convention). The pages are pure text otherwise — the paraneoplastic syndromes table (4 categories: musculoskeletal/cutaneous, endocrine, hematologic, neuromuscular; 16 entries) on book 224, the normal aging organ-system changes (10 systems: cardiovascular, GI, hematopoietic, immune, musculoskeletal, nervous, special senses, skin, renal, reproductive, respiratory) + Lipofuscin on book 225, and a mostly-blank NOTES page on book 226. The visual is an ORIGINAL KYP adaptation rendering the paraneoplastic table and the aging organ-system grid as panel maps (no source figure to redraw). The tables are carried verbatim in the note's table blocks. No margin mnemonics (VLM confirmed); the KYP memory layer is original.
